content.title: Juno Upgrade (v25)
content.description:
# Juno Upgrade (v25)

 This upgrade includes: Minor verion bumps and security patches. More details [here]](https://github.com/CosmosContracts/juno/releases/v25.0.0) .
 Code will be released Monday afternoon UTC.

 ## Voting Options
YES: Agree to proceed with the v25 network upgrade.
NO: Disagree with the v25 network upgrade.
